about: The ear's coverage walk (ear-coverage-walk.mjs) requires a speakable unit for every visible Japanese text node of the learner walk. Only these places are left out, each for a reason no ear can change. The walk refuses to run if this list holds anything but these two.

entries.name: the galaxy's canvas-drawn labels
entries.why: The galaxy draws some of its labels into a canvas. A canvas holds pixels, not text: there is no node for the ear to find. The galaxy's own word buttons are DOM and are walked.

entries.name: the Nihongo study frame
entries.why: Nihongo Study's own page inside Bunki, a separate document with its own voice path (the speech team's N2 ear).
